references.text: The Lord created confusion among the enemies, a theme repeated when God fights for Israel.
The Lord sent confusion over the Philistines, similar divine intervention as in Joshua.
The Lord created confusion in the enemy camp so that they attacked each other.
The Lord created confusion among the Egyptians; the same Hebrew word (הום) is used.
God promised to send His terror ahead of Israel and confuse all the peoples they met.
God promised to bring great confusion upon Israel's enemies until they were destroyed.
Continuation of the same event, where the Lord cast large stones from heaven.
Joshua's prayer that the sun would stand still over Gibeon during the same battle.
Aseka is mentioned as one of the cities in the lowland of Judah.
Makkedah is mentioned as one of the cities in the lowland of Judah.
